output.reason: Evidence states that the RBI (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 was withdrawn/repealed effective 2025-11-28, and that as of 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force. It also states that the 2014 levy of foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty on floating rate term loans was withdrawn/repealed by those 2025 directions effective 2026-01-01, and therefore as of 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force.
